notes: The recorded response deliberately misbehaves. Three of its four achievements are defective: two carry numbers the resume never contained (340, 250000), and one quotes a source span that does not appear in the document. This fixture exists to prove the business-validation guards fire on exactly those and leave the honest bullet alone.
